value.author: pptypst
value.layerInfo: A formula typeset with Typst, as editable vector outlines. Open Window > Scripts > PPTypst to write or change the formula.

typstSource: The Typst source this formula was typeset from. Edit it in the PPTypst window and press Update; changing it here does not re-typeset.
typstFontSize: The point size the formula was typeset at. Set it in the PPTypst window; to resize without re-typesetting, use the layer's Scale.
typstColours: Paint each outline in the colour Typst rendered it. Off means the layer's own Fill and Stroke control the appearance.
typstGeometry: The compiled outlines. Written by the PPTypst window; not meant to be edited by hand.
